definition.title: Find competitor complaints and draft replies
definition.description: A founder supplies their product, a competitor name, and a positioning note; the workflow finds recent public threads where people are frustrated with the competitor and drafts a reply for each one that introduces the founder's product without sounding like an ad.

competitor_name.title: Competitor name
competitor_name.description: The product or company people are complaining about.

your_product_name.title: Your product name
your_product_name.description: What you are offering as an alternative.

your_one_liner.title: Your positioning (one sentence)
your_one_liner.description: What your product does and who it is for. The reply will be grounded in this.

pain_points.title: Pain points to look for (optional)
pain_points.description: Specific complaints your product addresses, e.g. 'pricing', 'slow support', 'no API'.
